output.promise: This course is for an engineer who has already shipped an AI feature and needs an answer to a more useful question than "did the last demo look good?" In about 90 minutes, you will create a small, reproducible evaluation harness and use it to measure an offline replay of an LLM judge. The capstone prints a confusion matrix, precision, and recall against human labels.
output.title: Evals and LLM-as-Judge: A Grader You Can Trust
